title: AzureRender glTF Material Profile

styleParameters.description: Class-dependent style vector. Lit materials use toon/shadow/specular/rim. Brow-overlay uses bind-space island expansion in metres (clamped to 0.0012), Face-D ink expansion radius in texels and two reserved values. Named brow joints select islands; eyelash geometry is preserved. Card culling uses the standard glTF material.doubleSided property.

featureParameters.description: Class-dependent feature vector. Brow-overlay uses view offset, opacity, fade distance and base power.
